subject.title: feat: add dark skills.sh catalog control plane

question: Should ClawHub permanently own this Vercel-OIDC-to-Test skills.sh catalog control plane and its shared security-scan queue integration in the current staged form?
rationale: The patch deliberately introduces a long-lived privileged ingress and durable control surface; implementation tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the repository’s acceptable operational and security boundary.

options.title: Approve the staged boundary
options.body: Accept the Test-only OIDC bridge and dark defaults, then merge after the responsible owner completes targeted boundary review.

options.title: Split the boundary
options.body: Land fixture-only catalog state separately and defer the permanent Test OIDC/operator path to a narrower security-reviewed change.

options.title: Defer the initiative
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers decide whether skills.sh ingestion belongs in the current ClawHub roadmap.

recommendation.title: Approve the staged boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the Test-only OIDC bridge and dark defaults, then merge after the responsible owner completes targeted boundary review.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the control-plane design and supplied the staged Test proof, making them the best available routing contact for the implementation and rollout rationale.
